notes.failure_classification_detail: ci/checks/db/bundle-coherence.test.ts (T-0082, FF-13/AC-13) asserts NO choros."grant" row with resource_type='record' may have resource_facet IS NULL — the T-0082 ADR (docs/design/T-0082-bundle-coherence.adr.md:176) explicitly documents this as an INTENTIONALLY STRONGER-than-schema invariant: 'grant on a specific record without specifying which registry/record it references = a hanging grant = the object-schema<->grant desync from §7'. T-0570's ADR (docs/adr/ADR-T0570-read-pdp.md:98/153/265) explicitly designs the default-open READ grant with resource_facet=NULL meaning 'whole-resource ⇒ all fields visible' -- this is a direct, intentional-on-both-sides collision between two ADRs, not an accidental regression or a coder oversight in wiring. Anti-false-FAIL verification performed: (1) queried the live seeded DB directly -- exactly ONE grant with resource_type='record' AND resource_facet IS NULL exists in the dev-silo tenant (a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001), and its granted_by column is literally 'migration-115' (T-0570's own backfill migration), confirming the hanging grant is newly introduced by this task, not pre-existing debt; (2) confirmed migrations/115 is not applied on the branch's own merge-base (e2417705, only migrations up to 114 exist there) -- so on a pristine pre-T-0570 checkout this exact hanging-grant row cannot exist, meaning bundle-coherence.test.ts was green before this branch; (3) src/core/register.ts (T-0570's registerTenant additions, lines ~590-656) seeds the IDENTICAL resource_facet=NULL/resource_type='record' grant shape for EVERY newly-registered tenant going forward, so this is not a one-off backfill artifact confined to the dev-silo tenant -- FF-13 will be permanently red in the `db` CI job for every tenant after this task merges. This is a genuine product defect: the PR-handoff's friction_events entry lumping 'bundle-coherence' into '5 pre-existing unrelated reds... not touched by this task' is INCORRECT for this file -- the failure IS caused by files this task added (migrations/115_default_read_grant_backfill.sql + src/core/register.ts), verified live, not asserted from memory. Not a tooling-gap (the harness/docker/template setup worked correctly and the other 92 db-suite files passed clean) and not a wrong test (FF-13's intent — one row must unambiguously say which record/registry a narrow grant targets — is a deliberate, documented platform invariant that T-0570's own object_model directly contradicts for the default-open case). Verdict: fail, return to coder to either (a) get an explicit ADR-level reconciliation/exception for FF-13 covering the RESOURCE_ROOT sentinel case (mirroring how T-0570 already got a sanctioned exception for dual-control-isolation.sh via auto-sanction-additive.sh), or (b) encode the default-open grant's 'whole-resource' semantics without a NULL facet (e.g. an explicit sentinel facet value) so FF-13's invariant holds without carve-outs.
